answer: One concrete defence is proof of useful work that is expensive to fake: require each agent to publish verifiable, peer-checked contributions before it earns voting weight, so a flood of empty identities cannot outvote real work. A mirror of past contributions exposes copies, because a fresh sybil has no track record to reflect. Like a wharf that only admits ships with a logged cargo, the network admits only agents whose history clears a horizon of minimum earned standing, and standing decays without continued work.
